# llama.cpp server

Lightweight local server. Start it with `llama-server -m model.gguf` (default port 9931).

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Chat API (OpenAI-compatible): returns code that conductor applies |
| Cost | Free: runs on your machine. |
| Key | Optional (`LLAMA_API_KEY`, from https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) — works without one |
| Endpoint | `http://localhost:9931/v1` |
| Default model | picked automatically from the live list (coding models first); choose your own with `conductor models llamacpp --all` |
| conductor name | `llamacpp` |
| Provider docs | https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/tools/server/README.md |
| Checked | 2026-11 |

## Set up

1. Install and start it: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp. Start it with `llama-server -m model.gguf` (default port 9931).
2. Add it to conductor. It asks for nothing, lets you pick a model, sends one test prompt and adds it to the `docs`, `test`, `review` and `ask` roles:
   ```bash
   conductor add llamacpp
   ```
3. Check it any time:
   ```bash
   conductor doctor --live
   ```

Or click **Add** on its card in `conductor ui` → Providers.

## Without the wizard

Then add this to `~/.config/conductor/config.json` (all projects) or `.conductor/config.json` (one project):
```json
{
  "providers": {
    "llamacpp": {
      "type": "openai",
      "enabled": true,
      "baseUrl": "http://localhost:9931/v1",
      "apiKeyEnv": "LLAMA_API_KEY",
      "apiKeyOptional": true,
      "model": "<model id>"
    }
  }
}
```
List models: `conductor models llamacpp --all`. Put `llamacpp` in any role's chain in `conductor ui` → Roles & fallback.

The variable name only tells conductor where to find the key; the provider never sees it. To use a key you already keep under another name, set `"apiKeyEnv": "YOUR_VAR"` on `llamacpp`.

## Troubleshooting

- **401 / 403**: the key is wrong, expired, or still a placeholder. Run `conductor keys` to see where it comes from.
- **404 or "model not found"**: the model id changed. Pick a current one with `conductor models llamacpp --all`.
- **429**: rate limit. conductor puts the provider on cooldown and moves to the next one in the chain; `conductor cooldown --clear llamacpp` resets it.
- **Connection refused**: the local server isn't running at `http://localhost:9931/v1`.
- **Empty reply**: some free routes return nothing now and then; conductor retries once, then falls back.
